title: An operation whose weights are NOT installed is still dispatchable - and its rejection opens the bug-report dialog
description: Found live 2026-08-05 by the user on Wan 2.2. He has only the i2v weights installed; the app dispatched t2v_ms anyway, ComfyUI rejected the graph with 400 prompt_outputs_failed_validation, and that surfaced as the REPORT ON GITHUB error dialog. app.log names the real cause exactly: UNETLoader 95/96, "Value not in list: unet_name: 'Wan_22_t2v_High.safetensors' not in [...]" - the installed list holds Wan_22_i2v_High/Low but no t2v pair. TWO defects, and the first is the root. (1) AVAILABILITY: js/data/modelConstants/models.js gives wan-22 per-operation deps (operations.t2v_ms.deps = wan-22-t2v-high/low, operations.i2v_ms.deps = its own three), which the user opts in and out of per model - so the app KNOWS those weights are absent. resolveModelDeps.js:495 deriveInstalledOps already computes exactly that set and the Model Manager already uses it; the PromptBox op strip never consults it. The disable-reason hook is right there at MpiPromptBox.js:1251 ('paint a mask first' for requiresMask), so a sibling reason is the shape of the fix. wan-22 is the ONLY model with more than one op carrying its own weights today, which bounds the blast radius - but the gate belongs to the mechanism, not to wan-22. (2) ERROR SURFACE: a ComfyUI validation rejection is an expected, user-actionable state and must be a toast naming the missing weight, never MpiErrorDialog - which invites a bogus GitHub issue. The pattern already exists: MPI-229 turned the missing-LoRA case into a warning toast via _findNodeErrorLora in comfyController.js, reading node_errors[id].errors[].extra_info.received_value because the top-level details string is empty. unet_name (and ckpt_name / vae_name / clip_name) need the same treatment. Do NOT fix this by widening the dialog copy - that is the symptom.
acceptance: An operation whose per-op weights are not installed is NOT dispatchable - it reads as unavailable with a reason, the same way a masked op does without a mask
The reason routes the user somewhere useful (install that operation) rather than just refusing
A ComfyUI validation rejection surfaces as a toast naming the missing weight, never the REPORT ON GITHUB dialog - on BOTH engines, local and remote
The missing filename is read out of node_errors extra_info.received_value, since the top-level details string is empty whenever another output still validated
A test replays the REAL 400 body from app.log (not an imagined one) and asserts a toast-class error, not a reportable one
Wan 2.2 with only i2v installed: t2v is visibly unavailable, and nothing reaches ComfyUI to be rejected
